CREATE TABLE artist_profiles (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	normalized_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	canonical_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	aliases_json VARCHAR, 
	track_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scene_cluster VARCHAR, 
	primary_subgenre VARCHAR, 
	secondary_subgenres_json VARCHAR, 
	typical_bpm_min FLOAT, 
	typical_bpm_max FLOAT, 
	energy_min FLOAT, 
	energy_max FLOAT, 
	set_role_hints_json VARCHAR, 
	confidence_label VARCHAR, 
	needs_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	raw_llm_json VARCHAR, 
	last_enriched_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE artist_reviews (
	artist_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	baseline_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	candidate_json VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	error VARCHAR, 
	confirmed_choice VARCHAR, 
	confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (artist_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(artist_id) REFERENCES artist_profiles (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR, 
	entity_id INTEGER, 
	before_json VARCHAR, 
	after_json VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE duplicate_group_tracks (
	group_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (group_id, track_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES duplicate_groups (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE duplicate_groups (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE fingerprints (
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chromaprint VARCHAR, 
	duration_seconds FLOAT, 
	fingerprinted_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (track_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	total INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	processed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR, 
	error VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE play_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	set_id INTEGER, 
	played_at DATETIME, 
	context VARCHAR, 
	crowd_reaction INTEGER, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(set_id) REFERENCES sets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE saved_searches (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	"query" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	pinned BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE set_tracks (
	set_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (set_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(set_id) REFERENCES sets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE sets (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	date VARCHAR, 
	target_duration INTEGER, 
	target_bpm_arc VARCHAR, 
	target_energy_arc VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE soundcloud_match_candidates (
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	soundcloud_track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	reasons_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	evaluated_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	decided_at VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (track_id, soundcloud_track_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_soundcloud_match_candidates_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(soundcloud_track_id) REFERENCES soundcloud_tracks (soundcloud_track_id)
)

CREATE TABLE soundcloud_tracks (
	soundcloud_track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	urn VARCHAR, 
	permalink_url VARCHAR, 
	title VARCHAR, 
	uploader_id INTEGER, 
	uploader_username VARCHAR, 
	uploader_permalink_url VARCHAR, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	full_duration_ms INTEGER, 
	genre VARCHAR, 
	tag_list VARCHAR, 
	description VARCHAR, 
	label_name VARCHAR, 
	release_date VARCHAR, 
	created_at VARCHAR, 
	display_date VARCHAR, 
	liked_at VARCHAR, 
	likes_count INTEGER, 
	reposts_count INTEGER, 
	playback_count INTEGER, 
	comment_count INTEGER, 
	download_count INTEGER, 
	downloadable BOOLEAN, 
	artwork_url VARCHAR, 
	waveform_url VARCHAR, 
	publisher_metadata_json VARCHAR, 
	raw_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	available BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_run_id VARCHAR, 
	fetched_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (soundcloud_track_id)
)

CREATE TABLE tags (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE track_beatgrids (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_uuid VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	bpm FLOAT, 
	straight BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	anchor_s FLOAT, 
	first_downbeat_index INTEGER, 
	beats BLOB, 
	residual_ms FLOAT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	edited BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	key_index INTEGER, 
	source_version INTEGER, 
	imported_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_track_beatgrids_track_source UNIQUE (track_id, source), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE track_cues (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(120), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_track_cues_position_ms CHECK (typeof(position_ms) = 'integer' AND position_ms >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_track_cues_kind CHECK (kind IN ('entry', 'exit', 'cue')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_track_cues_label CHECK (label IS NULL OR length(label) <= 120), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE track_dj_profile (
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	energy INTEGER, 
	intensity INTEGER, 
	darkness INTEGER, 
	melody INTEGER, 
	weirdness INTEGER, 
	mixability INTEGER, 
	confidence INTEGER, 
	chaos_level INTEGER, 
	set_role VARCHAR, 
	transition_role VARCHAR, 
	groove_type VARCHAR, 
	vocal_density VARCHAR, 
	breakdown_profile VARCHAR, 
	drop_profile VARCHAR, 
	bassline_type VARCHAR, 
	lead_character VARCHAR, 
	psy_substyle VARCHAR, 
	festival_time VARCHAR, 
	ritual_factor VARCHAR, 
	crowd_risk VARCHAR, 
	personal_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tempo_bridge_score INTEGER, 
	bpm_jump_tolerance VARCHAR, 
	can_cut_into BOOLEAN, 
	can_cut_out_of BOOLEAN, 
	dramatic_transition_candidate BOOLEAN, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	human_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (track_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE track_downbeats (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	downbeat_s FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (track_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE track_pair_notes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	from_track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	to_track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rating INTEGER, 
	transition_type VARCHAR, 
	notes VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(from_track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(to_track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE track_soundcloud_matches (
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	soundcloud_track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reasons_json VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	matched_at VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (track_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(soundcloud_track_id) REFERENCES soundcloud_tracks (soundcloud_track_id)
)

CREATE TABLE track_tags (
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (track_id, tag_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES tracks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tag_id) REFERENCES tags (id)
)

CREATE TABLE tracks (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	absolute_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	volume_root VARCHAR, 
	file_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	extension VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	file_size INTEGER, 
	modified_time FLOAT, 
	created_time FLOAT, 
	duration FLOAT, 
	bitrate INTEGER, 
	sample_rate INTEGER, 
	channels INTEGER, 
	codec VARCHAR, 
	container VARCHAR, 
	artist VARCHAR, 
	artist_normalized VARCHAR, 
	title VARCHAR, 
	album VARCHAR, 
	label VARCHAR, 
	year INTEGER, 
	genre VARCHAR, 
	comment VARCHAR, 
	bpm FLOAT, 
	key_text VARCHAR, 
	rating INTEGER, 
	bpm_analyzed FLOAT, 
	bpm_analyzed_raw FLOAT, 
	bpm_analyzed_confidence FLOAT, 
	bpm_analyzed_method VARCHAR, 
	key_analyzed VARCHAR, 
	key_analyzed_confidence FLOAT, 
	analyzed_at DATETIME, 
	analysis_error VARCHAR, 
	bpm_essentia FLOAT, 
	bpm_essentia_confidence FLOAT, 
	bpm_essentia_method VARCHAR, 
	essentia_analyzed_at DATETIME, 
	essentia_error VARCHAR, 
	bpm_disagreement BOOLEAN, 
	bpm_disagreement_percent FLOAT, 
	bpm_reccobeats FLOAT, 
	reccobeats_track_id VARCHAR, 
	key_reccobeats VARCHAR, 
	reccobeats_source VARCHAR, 
	reccobeats_catalog_checked_at DATETIME, 
	reccobeats_catalog_error VARCHAR, 
	reccobeats_analyzed_at DATETIME, 
	reccobeats_error VARCHAR, 
	getsongbpm_song_id VARCHAR, 
	bpm_getsongbpm FLOAT, 
	key_getsongbpm VARCHAR, 
	getsongbpm_updated_at DATETIME, 
	getsongbpm_error VARCHAR, 
	bpm_consensus FLOAT, 
	bpm_consensus_sources VARCHAR, 
	bpm_needs_review BOOLEAN, 
	cyanite_track_id VARCHAR, 
	cyanite_status VARCHAR, 
	bpm_cyanite FLOAT, 
	bpm_cyanite_range_adjusted FLOAT, 
	key_cyanite VARCHAR, 
	cyanite_updated_at DATETIME, 
	cyanite_error VARCHAR, 
	quick_hash VARCHAR, 
	full_hash VARCHAR, 
	play_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_played_at DATETIME, 
	imported_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_scanned_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	missing BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE candidates(left_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id),right_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id),pair_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 score REAL NOT NULL,class TEXT NOT NULL,evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(left_id,right_id))
CREATE TABLE canonical_artists(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE canonical_base_entities(entity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,recording_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE canonical_blocks(left_id TEXT,right_id TEXT,reason TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(left_id,right_id))

CREATE TABLE canonical_events(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,recording_id TEXT,action TEXT NOT NULL,before_json TEXT,after_json TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE canonical_patterns(pattern TEXT PRIMARY KEY,report_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE canonical_recordings(
 recording_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT,artist TEXT,version TEXT,release TEXT,
 state TEXT NOT NULL,proposal_json TEXT NOT NULL,evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE collection_consolidation_events(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,decision_id TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE collection_consolidations(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,mode TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL,baseline_json TEXT NOT NULL,result_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE collection_position_dispositions(
 decision_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_position INTEGER NOT NULL,
 representative_id TEXT,representative_position INTEGER,disposition TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(decision_id,source_id,source_position,representative_id))

CREATE TABLE collection_presentation_overrides(
 collection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,decision_id TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE collection_relationship_events(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,relationship_id TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,before_json TEXT,after_json TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE collection_relationships(
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id),destination_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id),
 relation TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,confidence REAL NOT NULL,evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 decision_mode TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(source_id,destination_id))

CREATE TABLE collection_representation_bindings(
 decision_id TEXT NOT NULL,source_id TEXT NOT NULL,representative_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(decision_id,source_id,representative_id))
CREATE TABLE collections(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT,service TEXT,kind TEXT,track_count INTEGER,provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE entities(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,service TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT,artist TEXT,duration_ms REAL,
 local_track_id INTEGER,permalink TEXT,recording_id TEXT REFERENCES recordings(id),status TEXT NOT NULL,
 metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,normalized_json TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE identity_acceptances(
 left_id TEXT NOT NULL,right_id TEXT NOT NULL,match_source TEXT NOT NULL,confidence REAL NOT NULL,
 method TEXT NOT NULL,evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 acceptance_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(acceptance_mode IN ('human','deterministic','auto_high_confidence')),
 revoked_at TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(left_id,right_id))

CREATE TABLE memberships(collection_id TEXT REFERENCES collections(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT REFERENCES entities(id),
 added_at TEXT,source_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,position))
CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE recording_artists(
 recording_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES canonical_recordings(recording_id),artist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES canonical_artists(id),
 credit_order INTEGER NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('primary','collaborator','featured','remixer')),
 PRIMARY KEY(recording_id,credit_order))

CREATE TABLE recording_recovery(
 recording_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES canonical_recordings(recording_id),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('wanted','acquired','skipped','unavailable')),
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE recordings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE recovery_events(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,recording_id TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX candidates_class ON candidates(class,score)
CREATE INDEX candidates_right ON candidates(right_id,class)
CREATE INDEX canonical_artist_name ON canonical_artists(normalized_name)
CREATE INDEX entities_local_track_id ON entities(local_track_id)
CREATE INDEX entities_recording ON entities(recording_id)
CREATE INDEX entities_recording_service ON entities(recording_id,service,id)
CREATE INDEX entities_service_status ON entities(service,status)
CREATE INDEX entities_title ON entities(title)
CREATE INDEX memberships_entity ON memberships(entity_id)
